paragraphs.text:
Your  party  advances  silently,  and  you  see  movement  ahead. 
When shapes emerge from the evergreens, you see that one 
of them is Bernard, carried upon the shoulders of three short 
gray figures.

To follow the bearers and their captive, go to 133. To shout to scare 
them off, go to 134. To shoot at the bearers, go to 135.
